one_liner: TranscriptAPI (transcriptapi.com) is a hosted REST API for YouTube transcripts, search, channels and playlists. It uses a self-serve Bearer API key, has 100 free credits, and has an official MCP server.
auth_notes: Bearer API key in the Authorization header, generated from the dashboard API Keys page. The MCP connector uses OAuth, but the REST API documents only API keys.
access_notes: New accounts get 100 free credits. Paid plans start at $5/month, and a transcript costs 1 credit.
blocker_notes: No blocker. Usage is credit-metered after the free tier. Breadth is inferred from the docs: transcript, search, channel and playlist endpoints. The evidence does not give an endpoint count.
